title: Frontend Portfolio page — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #65 (frontend-portfolio-page), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: PositionsTable.tsx's handleConfirmDelete has a defensive `if (!pendingDelete) return` guard (needed only so TypeScript narrows `pendingDelete` before reading `.id`) that's unreachable in practice — ConfirmDialog's `onConfirm` only fires while `pendingDelete !== null` is what keeps it open. This is the one uncovered branch in an otherwise ~99.5%-covered PR (vitest coverage report: PositionsTable.tsx line 87). Not worth a behavior change, but either add a direct unit test exercising it (e.g. calling the handler with no pending delete via a more invasive test) or leave a short comment noting it's intentionally-defensive dead code for the type-narrowing, so a future coverage-gap sweep doesn't re-flag it as a mystery.
